thread:
liam_support: Heads up — spoke with Greenfield AI (Sara). They're seeing embed ingestion failures in prod and feel onboarding stalled. Sara said training timelines weren't met and asked about escalation. They explicitly flagged renewal as at-risk. Escalating to CS. Ticket: https://redwood.support/tickets/3427

liam_support: Key facts: committed seats=3, next renewal=2025-01-10, error rate ~15% on batch ingest, sample error: "tokenization mismatch". I've attached logs to the ticket. @nora_cs_manager can you take point? :warning:

nora_cs_manager: Thanks Liam. Need a quick summary of the gap + any immediate workaround we can offer. Plan I propose:
1) Confirm short-term workaround to reduce errors within 2 hours
2) Run an enablement session + demo this week (skills transfer)
3) Offer a goodwill credit and capture feedback for docs
I'll own the renewal-risk flag and exec summary. @emma_cs can you own customer comms?

emma_cs: Yep — I can send an outreach. Drafting now, will ping in 30m. Proposed ask: confirm workaround, schedule 60min enablement (screen share + ingest walkthrough), collect top 3 pain points.

devon_se: Taking a look at the logs now. Suspect tokenizer/encoding mismatch on their ingest pipeline. Will try to repro and push a hotfix to staging in ~2h. If confirmed I'll open a PR and request a canary. @oncall-bot please schedule canary for fleet-embed-v2 once PR is merged. :hammer_and_wrench:

oncall-bot: Canary deployment scheduled — fleet-embed-v2 -> canary on 2024-07-18T14:10Z. Monitoring hooks enabled.

liam_support: FYI Sara mentioned docs confusion around caching + rate limits; we should capture that in the enablement. Also they asked for an interim higher throughput while fix is applied.

ashley_finance: Pre-approval: up to $2,000 credit for customer-impact incidents OK. For anything >$2k, loop me and @finance-team.

nora_cs_manager: Communication plan (short):
- 0-2h: Liam posts ticket update with workaround and ETA for fix.
- 0-8h: Emma sends a personalized note to Sara + proposed times for enablement.
- 24-48h: Devon validates fix in canary, roll to staging, then prod if green.
- 48-72h: Enablement session + doc update committed.
- Executive: I'll prepare a 1-pager for CSM lead and AE summarizing risk and remediation.

emma_cs: Draft email ready, will send after Liam confirms workaround in ticket. Copying AE and Sara's CSM.

devon_se: Quick notes for triage: extracting sample log, running tokenizer parity check, will include a small ingest script to reproduce. If workaround needed, suggest adding an input normalizer step (strip nulls + enforce UTF-8).

liam_support: Updated ticket with logs + suggested temporary workaround (normalize input on client side). Sara acknowledged and is open to enablement session Fri 2pm PT. She wants us to confirm credits and timeline.

nora_cs_manager: Assignments: Emma = outreach & session owner, Devon = fix & deployment, Liam = ticket updates & workaround follow-through, Nora = renewal risk & exec summary, Ashley = credit approval. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: when you've noted your action.

emma_cs: :thumbsup: Will send now and include calendar invite for Fri 2pm PT.

devon_se: :thumbsup: Starting reproduce now.

liam_support: :thumbsup: I'll keep ticket running notes.

ashley_finance: :thumbsup: Confirmed $2k credit approved for this incident.

nora_cs_manager: Thanks team — let's close the loop on the 2h workaround and confirm canary results. I'll follow up with an exec note after the fix is validated.

(oncall-bot note: deploy + observability alerts will post back to the ticket channel when canary completes.)
